description: Sets which Analytics events count as conversions for one of the organization's websites, and the paths whose events are left out. Conversions are re-read from Analytics with the next refresh. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.

events.description: One Analytics event name per line; the counted set becomes exactly these (none: the property's key events count).

exclude_paths.description: One path prefix per line (e.g. /careers) whose events are not leads; the set becomes exactly these.

name: webops_set_conversions
title: Set the conversions counted
